items.title: South Korean semiconductor expert: Nvidia wants to cut HBM demand, but ends up boosting NAND flash demand
items.title_zh: 韩国半导体专家：英伟达想要减少HBM需求，却增加了闪存需求
items.summary: On August 19, a South Korean tech business channel reported that a Korean semiconductor expert said on a program that, to break through the physical limits of GPU memory, Nvidia is adopting external SSD solutions—linking petabyte-scale storage pools via fiber or copper cable and replacing costly HBM with the zig-zag stacking structure of NAND flash.
items.summary_zh: 8月19日，据韩国科技商业频道，韩国半导体专家在节目上表示，英伟达为突破GPU存储物理限制，采用外置SSD方案，通过光纤或铜缆连接数百TB超大容量存储池，以NAND闪存的Z字形堆叠结构替代高成本HBM

items.title: Typhoon 'Sandalwood' affects southern South China and the South China Sea; multiple departments consult on flood and typhoon response

items.title: Chinese embassy in Vietnam warns citizens to guard against Typhoon 'Sandalwood'

items.summary: According to forecasts from Chinese and Vietnamese meteorological authorities, on the morning of August 22 Typhoon 'Sandalwood' was located near the waters off Quang Ninh Province and Haiphong City in Vietnam, moving steadily southwest with maximum sustained winds of force 8 and gusts up to force 10.

items.title: Wang Yi meets Luhut, chairman of Indonesia's National Economic Council
items.title_zh: 王毅会见印尼国家经济委员会主席卢胡特
items.summary: On August 22 in Jakarta, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs, met with Luhut, chairman of Indonesia's National Economic Council.

items.title: Guangdong development reform commission unveils measures to expand and upgrade the credit services industry
items.title_zh: 广东省发展改革委出台推动信用服务业扩能提质若干措施
items.summary: The Guangdong Provincial Development and Reform Commission recently issued 'Several Measures to Expand and Upgrade Credit Services,' rolling out 21 concrete initiatives across four directions—scenario expansion, entity cultivation, cross-border cooperation, and environment optimization—to further stimulate the credit-services market and improve the province's business environment.
items.summary_zh: 【广东省发展改革委出台推动信用服务业扩能提质若干措施】财联社8月22日电，广东省发展改革委近日印发《推动信用服务业扩能提质的若干措施》，围绕场景拓展、主体培育、跨境合作、环境优化四大方向推出21项具体举措，进一步激发信用服务市场活力，推动行业扩规模、提质量、增效能，助力全省营商环境持续优化

items.title: Multiple banks announce raising per-person interest-subsidy cap at a single bank to 5,000 yuan
items.title_zh: 多家银行发布公告 单人在同家银行贴息上限提升到5000元
items.summary: Today (the 22nd), reporters learned from the six major banks—ICBC, Agricultural Bank of China, Bank of China, China Construction Bank, Bank of Communications, and Postal Savings Bank—that, in accordance with the notice from the Ministry of Finance, the People's Bank of China, and the Financial Regulatory Authority on further coordinating fiscal and financial policy to boost domestic demand, the banks have issued notices clarifying the latest credit-card installment interest-subsidy cap.
items.summary_zh: 【多家银行发布公告 单人在同家银行贴息上限提升到5000元】财联社8月22日电，记者今天（22日）从工商银行、农业银行、中国银行、建设银行、交通银行、邮储银行等六大银行了解到，各家银行已经根据财政部、中国人民银行、金融监管总局《关于进一步做好财政金融协同促内需政策有关工作的通知》，陆续发布公告，明确了最新的信用卡分期贴

items.title: Iran says its defense production capacity has doubled
items.title_zh: 伊朗称国防产能已翻倍
items.summary: On August 21, Iranian Defense Ministry spokesman Reza Talaei-Nik told state television that, despite strikes on some defense-industrial facilities, Iran's defense equipment and weapons production capacity has doubled over the past year, enabling it to rapidly replenish output while equipment is consumed on the battlefield.
items.summary_zh: 【伊朗称国防产能已翻倍】财联社8月22日电，伊朗国防部发言人礼萨·塔拉埃-尼克8月21日接受伊朗国家电视台采访时表示，尽管部分国防工业设施遭到袭击，但伊朗国防装备与武器产能在过去一年已实现翻番，能够在战场持续消耗武器装备的同时迅速补充生产

items.title: 18 rivers nationwide still above alert levels; Ministry of Water Resources keeps yellow flood warning

items.summary_zh: 【全国18条河流仍维持超警 水利部维持洪水黄色预警】财联社8月22日电，截至今天（22日）9时，黑龙江、浙江、江苏等地18条河流仍维持超警，最大超警幅度2.40米，其中3条河流维持超保

items.title: Australia's capital territory joins gun buyback program

items.summary: On August 22, Australian Prime Minister Albanese announced that the Australian Capital Territory, which includes the capital Canberra, will join the gun buyback program, further implementing measures to tighten gun control adopted after last year's Bondi Beach shooting in Sydney.
items.summary_zh: 【澳大利亚首都加入枪支回购计划】财联社8月22日电，澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯22日宣布，首都堪培拉所属的澳大利亚首都直辖区将加入枪支回购计划，以进一步落实去年悉尼邦迪滩枪击事件后政府收紧枪支管控的相关举措

items.title: Molten-salt storage tanks at world's highest-altitude solar thermal plant pass hydrostatic test

items.summary: According to PowerChina, the hydrostatic test of the molten-salt storage tanks at the Tibet Kaido Anduo concentrated solar thermal project it is building recently succeeded on the first attempt, marking full verification of the core heat-storage equipment installation and a key step toward full-capacity grid connection for the world's highest-altitude and Tibet's first tower-type solar thermal plant.
items.summary_zh: 【世界海拔最高光热电站熔盐储罐通过充水试验】财联社8月22日电，据中国电建消息，近日，由中国电建承建的西藏开投安多光热项目熔盐储罐充水试验一次性圆满成功，标志着项目储热系统核心设备安装质量全面核验合格，这座世界海拔最高、西藏首个塔式光热工程向全容量并网发电目标又迈出了关键一步
